data.name: Starla
data.long_meaning: In ancient Greek mythology, Starla was a name given to the goddess Aphrodite, who was believed to protect mariners and sailors at sea. The name Starla, derived from the Greek word for star (aster) and sea (thalassa), symbolizes guidance and protection for those who navigate through life's uncertainties.

This name is a constant reminder that we are never alone, that God is always with us, and that He will lead us to safety and salvation.
